At a rate of 58 only the expense is flagged (through original_amount); the transfer row is selected for import ("Import 1 row" covers it) and would post a second transfer of ₱5,800.00. src/lib/importDuplicates.ts `matchDuplicates` files every movement (isMovement) only under `transferKey`, keyed on the converted amount, and never under `originals`, although the stored transfer has original_amount 100.00 USD. ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: (a) The same converted file at another rate flags its transfer rows; (b) a transfer into the account is matched by the amount that arrived as before; (c) unit tests in importDuplicates.test for an outbound and an inbound converted transfer at a changed rate; (d) re-run LED-188 item 3c.

SUMMARY: Editing a row into a transfer to a card records no card payment
USER_STORY: As a user who fixes a mis-recorded card payment, I want the edit to log the payment like a new one would, so the card's payment history and statement agree with its balance.
DESCRIPTION: Found by LED-208 (knowledge/retros/2026-10-02-live-sweep-sheet-edits-offline.md). Observed at 390, demo user: "Visa payment" (a 700.00 transfer to Visa Platinum with its credit_card_payments row) edited Kind Transfer → Expense removes the payment row and reverts the card's last payment, correctly (LED-191 trigger). Edited back, Kind Expense → Transfer, To account Visa Platinum: the balances return (Visa −1,528.74, checking unchanged) but no credit_card_payments row is created, and the card's last payment stays 650.00 on 2026-08-10. Every create path runs the statement steps for a transfer into a card (useCardPayment.createWithStatement for the Card payment kind and a plain Transfer, recordGenerated for recurring rows, recordSynced for a queued one); the update path does not, and the LED-191 trigger in supabase/migrations/20261001100000_card_payment_follows_its_transfer.sql only updates or deletes a linked row. The same gap applies when an existing transfer's destination is moved onto a card. Suggested fix: on update, when the row becomes a transfer into a card and has no linked payment, run the same statement steps as a create (client path through useCardPayment, or an insert branch in the trigger with the statement update kept client-side); cover a queued edit too.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: (a) Expense → Transfer to a card creates one linked payment row and updates the card's last payment and statement as a new payment does; (b) moving a transfer's destination from savings to a card does the same, and from a card to savings removes it; (c) a queued edit gets the same result on drain; (d) balances unchanged from today's behaviour; (e) re-run the LED-208 kind-switch check.
